buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 5. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 6. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Commander HQ 24 BRTF payable at 600000 . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.The bidder shall carefully examine the complete bid document and satisfy itse lf regarding the technical specifications, quantities, delivery location, installation requirements and other contractual obligations before submitting its bid. 2.All quoted rates shall be inclusive of the costs necessary for supply and fulfilm ent of the contractual requirements, including packing, forwarding, transportati

on, transit insurance, unloading, placement, installation, commissioning, testing , demonstration, accessories and applicable taxes, as relevant to the item and b id price structure. 3.No additional payment shall be admissible for any component, accessory, fitti ng, consumable required for initial commissioning or incidental service that is e xpressly included in the bid specifications or ATC. 4.The bidder shall submit all documents required by the GeM bid, including appl icable declarations, technical compliance documents and manufacturer authoriz ation wherever specifically required. 5.The bidder shall declare that the offered products are new, unused, genuine a nd free from manufacturing defects. Refurbished, reconditioned, used or counte rfeit products shall not be accepted. 6.Any exemption claimed by a bidder from an eligibility condition, experience r equirement, turnover requirement or other bid provision shall be supported by valid documentary evidence and shall be subject to the applicable procurement policy and GeM provisions. 7.The bidder shall not submit false, misleading or materially incorrect informatio n. Any such submission shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable Ge M GTC and procurement rules. 8.Where a specification mentions a make followed by “Equivalent”, the bidder may offer another make only if the offered product meets or exceeds the prescr ibed functional, technical, quality and performance requirements. 9.The bidder shall submit a technical compliance statement against the specific ations of each quoted item, wherever required by the bid. The statement shall i dentify the offered make, model, capacity, dimensions, material, performance p arameters and relevant deviations, if any. 10.The bidder shall clearly identify the exact model being offered. General catal ogues, brochures or descriptions covering several models shall not substitute fo r identification of the specific offered model. 11.Technical literature, product datasheets, manufacturer's specifications, relev ant test reports and photographs shall be submitted wherever necessary to esta blish compliance. 12. The bidder shall ensure that all items supplied under the contract are comp atible with the intended use, available power supply, existing equipment and sit e conditions, wherever relevant. 13. Products bearing altered, removed, duplicated or tampered serial numbers, labels, warranty seals or identification markings shall be liable for rejection. 14.The supplier shall deliver the complete ordered quantity to the consignee an d delivery location specified in the GeM contract/supply order within the stipulat ed delivery period. 15. The supplier shall be responsible for safe packing, transportation, transit ins urance, handling and unloading of the goods up to the designated delivery point , as applicable under the bid. 16.Goods shall be delivered in proper condition, free from transit damage, mois

ture damage, breakage, corrosion, missing components or other defects. 17.Delivery challan, invoice, packing list, warranty details, serial number list an d other relevant documents shall accompany the consignment, as applicable. 18.Delivery of goods at the site shall not, by itself, constitute final acceptance. Acceptance shall be subject to inspection, verification and satisfactory performa nce in accordance with the contract. 19.The supplier shall promptly inform the consignee of any anticipated delay an d shall seek extension only through the applicable contractual procedure. An ex tension shall not be considered approved unless granted by the competent auth ority through the prescribed process. 20.All items shall be packed suitably to prevent damage during transportation, l oading, unloading and storage. Packaging shall identify the product, make, mod el, quantity and relevant handling instructions, where applicable. 21.Furniture, glass-top tables, mirrors, electrical appliances, lighting equipment and other fragile or bulky items shall be protected with suitable cushioning, edg e protection and secure packing. 22.The supplier shall replace any item damaged during transit or handling, with out additional cost to the purchaser. 23.The purchaser or its authorized representative shall have the right to inspect and verify the supplied items against the contract specifications. 24.Inspection may include verification of quantity, make, model, dimensions, m aterial, finish, capacity, accessories, safety features, serial numbers, document ation and physical condition. 25.Equipment requiring installation or commissioning shall be inspected and tes ted after installation, as applicable. 26.The supplier shall provide reasonable assistance, technical personnel, tools, testing arrangements and demonstrations required for inspection and acceptan ce, without additional cost where included in the contract. 27.The purchaser may reject goods that are defective, damaged, incomplete, c ounterfeit, materially non-compliant or otherwise not in accordance with the co ntract. 28.Rejected items shall be removed and replaced by the supplier within the peri od stipulated by the purchaser, subject to the applicable GeM contract provision s. All costs associated with removal, replacement and re-delivery shall be borne by the supplier where rejection is attributable to supplier non-compliance. 29.For items where installation, commissioning or demonstration is expressly specified, the supplier shall provide these services at the designated site.The su pplier shall arrange qualified and competent personnel, tools, equipment and n ecessary installation accessories. 30.Installation shall be carried out in accordance with the manufacturer's instru ctions, applicable safety requirements and site conditions.The supplier shall coo rdinate with the consignee regarding installation schedules, access to the premi ses and availability of utilities.

31.Following installation, the supplier shall conduct functional testing and demo nstrate the operation, safety features and basic maintenance requirements of t he equipment to the nominated representative. 32.The supplier shall rectify installation-related defects and complete commissi oning before the item is offered for final acceptance. Installation, commissionin g and demonstration certificates shall be submitted wherever applicable. 33.All goods shall carry the manufacturer's warranty or the warranty period spe cifically stipulated in the bid, whichever contractual requirement is applicable. 34.Warranty shall cover manufacturing defects, defects in materials and workm anship and failures arising during normal use in accordance with the manufactu rer's operating instructions. 35.During the warranty period, the supplier shall repair or replace defective co mponents or equipment, as appropriate, without charging the purchaser for cov ered parts, labour or service visits. 36.The supplier shall provide warranty support through its own service facility o r authorised service network. The supplier shall provide the relevant service con tact details and escalation mechanism. 37.The supplier shall acknowledge warranty complaints within a reasonable tim e and attend to them within the response and resolution periods specified in th e GeM contract or manufacturer's warranty terms, where applicable. 38.If the equipment cannot be repaired within a reasonable period, the supplier shall provide a suitable replacement or other remedy in accordance with the co ntract. 39.Warranty shall not be reduced or invalidated by the supplier's failure to hand over warranty documents, provided the purchaser has fulfilled the applicable co ntractual requirements. 40.Any exclusion for damage arising from misuse, unauthorized repair, abnorm al operating conditions or other causes shall be subject to the manufacturer's w arranty and the applicable contract. Such exclusions shall not be used to avoid responsibility for manufacturing defects or supplier-related installation deficienc ies. 41.The supplier shall provide the following documents, as applicable to the item : (a) Manufacturer's user/operating manual. (b) Installation and commissioning instructions. (c) Warranty card or warranty certificate. (d) Product datasheet and technical specifications.

(e) Serial number and model identification details. (f) Safety instructions and maintenance schedule. (g) Electrical diagrams, plumbing diagrams or other technical drawings, wherev er applicable. (h) Test reports, compliance certificates and service contact details, wherever r equired. 42.Manuals and operating instructions shall be supplied in English or in another language acceptable to the consignee. The supplier shall explain the safe opera tion, basic troubleshooting, cleaning and routine maintenance of equipment req uiring user familiarisation. 43.Electrical and electronic equipment shall be suitable for the voltage, frequen cy and power supply available at the delivery location, as prescribed in the rele vant specifications.The supplied equipment shall comply with applicable Indian safety standards, statutory requirements and mandatory certifications relevant to the product category. 44.Where BIS certification, energy-efficiency labelling or another statutory certif ication is mandatory for the offered product, the bidder shall ensure valid compl iance. 45.Electrical connections, wiring, earthing and installation shall be carried out b y competent personnel in accordance with applicable safety requirements. Equi pment shall be supplied with necessary protective devices, plugs, cables, conne ctors, controls and accessories as required by the specifications. 46.Any safety defect, exposed wiring, inadequate earthing, unsafe mounting or defective protection device identified during inspection shall be rectified before acceptance. 47.For executive chairs, visitor chairs, sofas, center tables, peg tables, beds, dr essing tables, bedside tables, almirahs, dining sets, wooden chairs, easy chairs and charpoys. (a) Furniture shall be new, structurally sound, properly finished and free from sh arp edges, splinters, loose joints, cracks, dents or visible manufacturing defects . (b) The supplied material, dimensions, upholstery, cushioning, frame constructi on, finish and accessories shall conform to the relevant item specification. (c) Wooden furniture shall be supplied with the specified solid wood, plywood, M

DF or other construction material, as applicable to the item. The supplier shall n ot substitute a specified material without approval. (d) Beds supplied with mattresses shall include the specified mattress size and t hickness. The mattress shall fit the bed frame and shall be free from sagging, d amage or manufacturing defects. (e) Sofa upholstery shall be of the specified leatherette finish and colour. The se ating and backrest shall be properly cushioned and securely assembled. (f) Office chairs shall have functional height adjustment, swivel, tilt or other mec hanisms where specified. The base, castors, armrests and adjustment mechanis ms shall be checked during inspection. (g) Steel almirahs shall conform to the specified dimensions, sheet gauge, shelv es, primer and paint finish. The doors, hinges, handles and locking arrangement , where specified, shall operate properly. (h) Foldable dining tables and chairs shall have secure folding and locking mech anisms. The supplier shall demonstrate safe folding, unfolding and stability. (i) The supplier shall assemble furniture at the delivery site wherever required f or complete and safe use. Furniture shall be placed at the location indicated by the consignee. (j) All furniture shall be stable under normal intended use. Any wobbling, loose f itting or assembly defect shall be rectified before acceptance. 48.Mobile tower light (a) The mobile tower light shall conform to the prescribed LED wattage, mast he ight, mast type, raising mechanism, rotation, generator capacity, engine, fuel ta nk, running time, starting system, control panel, trailer, tyres, stabilisers, brakin g system, dimensions, weight, IP rating and electrical system. (b) The supplier shall provide the complete equipment, including the specified g enerator, mast, floodlights, trailer, stabilisers, control panel, electrical connectio ns and standard accessories necessary for operation. (c) The supplier shall demonstrate raising and lowering of the mast, operation o f the floodlights, generator starting and shutdown, manual rotation, stabiliser d eployment and safety arrangements.

(d) The supplier shall provide the operating manual, maintenance schedule, eng ine documentation, warranty certificate and safety instructions. (e) The supplier shall demonstrate safe towing and parking arrangements, wher e applicable, and explain the precautions for mast operation, stabilisation and o peration in adverse weather. (f) The specified 12-month warranty shall apply, subject to the contract. The su pplier shall provide warranty service for the generator, lighting system and asso ciated equipment as covered by the warranty. 49.Fans, water dispensers, washing machine, coffee/tea brewer and household appliances (a) The equipment shall conform to the prescribed capacity, size, type, make/m odel and functional features. (b) The supplier shall provide the necessary standard accessories, power cable, controls, fittings and user manual required for normal operation. (c) For washing machines, the supplier shall demonstrate the basic operating fu nctions and provide installation instructions. Water inlet and outlet arrangemen ts shall be verified at site. (d) For floor-standing hot-and-cold water dispensers, the supplier shall demonst rate both functions, controls and safe operation. (e) For mist pedestal fans, the supplier shall demonstrate the fan and misting fu nctions, water tank and controls, where applicable. (f) The supplier shall provide operating instructions, warranty documentation an d service contact details for each appliance. 50.Inverter and batteries (a) The inverter and batteries shall conform to the specified rating, quantity, co mpatibility and make/model requirements. (b) The supplier shall ensure compatibility between the inverter and the supplie

d batteries and shall provide all standard connecting accessories necessary for the specified system. (c) Installation and electrical connection, where included in the contract, shall b e carried out by competent personnel with appropriate safety precautions. (d) The supplier shall demonstrate charging, output operation and basic protect ion functions, as applicable. (e) The battery warranty shall be as specified by the manufacturer and the bid. The supplier shall provide warranty documents for each battery and the inverte r. 51.LED televisions (a) The televisions shall conform to the screen size, resolution, panel type, refre sh rate, HDR features, brightness, sound output, operating system, connectivity , memory and storage parameters specified for the respective item. (b) The supplier shall deliver the television with the standard remote control, po wer cable, stand, batteries and other accessories included by the manufacturer. (c) The supplier shall demonstrate basic operation, display, sound, connectivity and relevant smart-TV functions. (d) Wall mounting, installation or additional mounting brackets shall be included only where expressly specified in the bid or approved by the purchaser. (e) The supplier shall provide warranty documentation and manufacturer servic e details. 52.RO water purification system (a) The RO system shall conform to the specified capacity, membrane, motor, p re-filters, UV steriliser, SS 304 frame, control panel, pressure gauges, flow mete rs, TDS meter, automatic controls, protections and membrane flushing arrange ment. (b) The supplier shall provide complete installation and commissioning, includin g the accessories and fittings included in the approved scope.

(c) The supplier shall verify source-water conditions and site requirements befor e installation. Any water-quality limitation or additional treatment requirement s hall be brought to the notice of the purchaser. (d) The supplier shall conduct commissioning tests and demonstrate system op eration, TDS measurement, automatic start/stop, flushing and relevant protectio n functions. (e) The supplier shall provide a maintenance schedule, filter and membrane rep lacement details, operating manual and service contact details. (f) The supplier shall fulfil the maintenance period expressly specified in the fin al bid. The period shall include the agreed preventive maintenance visits and co vered service obligations. (g) The ATC shall not be interpreted as requiring an unspecified quantity of repl acement membranes, filters or consumables during maintenance. Their inclusio n, replacement frequency and cost shall be clearly defined in the bid before pub lication. 53.Geysers and water heaters (a) The geysers shall conform to the specified storage capacity, make/model an d installation requirements. (b) Installation shall include the standard mounting and connection accessories specified in the bid. (c) The supplier shall verify suitable mounting, water connections, electrical sup ply and earthing before commissioning. (d) The supplier shall demonstrate normal operation and safety features, includi ng relevant temperature and protection controls. (e) The supplier shall provide the operating manual, warranty details and maint enance instructions. 53.High-mast lighting systems

(a) The on-grid and off-grid high-mast systems shall conform to the specified m ast height, lighting wattage, number of luminaires, construction, galvanisation, raising/lowering mechanism and safety arrangements. (b) The off-grid system shall additionally conform to the specified solar-panel ca pacity, battery voltage and capacity, energy storage, MPPT controller and lumin aire protection rating. (c) The supplier shall provide the complete system, including the components, c ontrol equipment, wiring, mast accessories, earthing and other items specified i n the bid. (d) Installation shall include the approved foundation and associated civil/electri cal works only to the extent expressly included in the bid. The scope and respo nsibility for foundation design, excavation, concreting, reinforcement, cabling a nd restoration shall be clearly stated before publication. (e) The supplier shall demonstrate the mast lowering and raising mechanism, li ghting operation, controller operation and relevant safety features. (f) The supplier shall provide installation drawings, foundation details, operating and maintenance manuals, test records and commissioning certificate. (g) The specified five-year maintenance obligation shall be fulfilled in accordanc e with the approved bid. The bid shall clearly define the scope of preventive mai ntenance, fault rectification, replacement parts and response times. 54.Refrigerators and chest freezers (a) The refrigerators and chest freezers shall conform to the specified capacity, type, make/model and operating requirements. (b) The supplier shall provide all standard accessories and operating instruction s. (c) The supplier shall demonstrate normal operation and explain the manufactur er's recommended installation clearances, ventilation and operating precaution s. (d) The supplier shall provide warranty documentation and service contact

details. 55.Wet grinders (a) The wet grinder shall conform to the specified capacity, tilting arrangement, granite rollers, SS 304 drum, motor rating, voltage, copper winding, roller quant ity, detachable drum, locking mechanism, gearbox, belt and overload protectio n. (b) The supplier shall demonstrate operation, tilting, drum removal and relevant safety features. (c) The equipment shall be checked for excessive vibration, abnormal noise, lea kage, overheating and proper operation of the locking mechanism. (d) The supplier shall provide the operating manual, warranty certificate and m aintenance instructions. 56.The quoted price shall cover all contractual obligations applicable to the ite m, including delivery, installation, commissioning, demonstration and maintena nce where specified. 57. Bidder should undertake and submit a certificate on 100/- stamp paper duly attested that presently he is not “Debarred from Bidding” on grounds mentione d in Rule 151 of GFR 2107 (Latest). 58.Payment shall be processed in accordance with the GeM GTC and the resulta nt contract, subject to satisfactory delivery, inspection, acceptance and submiss ion of the required documents. Payment shall not be due for rejected, undeliver ed or unaccepted goods except as expressly provided in the applicable contract . 59.Delay, non-delivery, incomplete delivery, failure to install or commission, fail ure to replace rejected goods or other contractual defaults shall be dealt with u nder the applicable GeM GTC and contract provisions. 60.Submission of a bid shall be deemed to indicate that the bidder has examine d the bid documents and agrees to comply with the applicable terms and condit ions, subject to the declarations and provisions required by GeM. 61.The purchaser shall reserve the right to verify compliance, inspect the goods , seek clarification, reject non-compliant supplies and enforce contractual reme dies in accordance with the GeM GTC and the contract. .

1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 5. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 6. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. on, transit insurance, unloading, placement, installation, commissioning, testing , demonstration, accessories and applicable taxes, as relevant to the item and b id price structure. 3.No additional payment shall be admissible for any component, accessory, fitti ng, consumable required for initial commissioning or incidental service that is e xpressly included in the bid specifications or ATC. 4.The bidder shall submit all documents required by the GeM bid, including appl icable declarations, technical compliance documents and manufacturer authoriz ation wherever specifically required. 5.The bidder shall declare that the offered products are new, unused, genuine a nd free from manufacturing defects. The statement shall i dentify the offered make, model, capacity, dimensions, material, performance p arameters and relevant deviations, if any. 10.The bidder shall clearly identify the exact model being offered. General catal ogues, brochures or descriptions covering several models shall not substitute fo r identification of the specific offered model. 11.Technical literature, product datasheets, manufacturer's specifications, relev ant test reports and photographs shall be submitted wherever necessary to esta blish compliance. 12. Products bearing altered, removed, duplicated or tampered serial numbers, labels, warranty seals or identification markings shall be liable for rejection. 14.The supplier shall deliver the complete ordered quantity to the consignee an d delivery location specified in the GeM contract/supply order within the stipulat ed delivery period. 15. ture damage, breakage, corrosion, missing components or other defects. 17.Delivery challan, invoice, packing list, warranty details, serial number list an d other relevant documents shall accompany the consignment, as applicable. 18.Delivery of goods at the site shall not, by itself, constitute final acceptance. Acceptance shall be subject to inspection, verification and satisfactory performa nce in accordance with the contract. 19.The supplier shall promptly inform the consignee of any anticipated delay an d shall seek extension only through the applicable contractual procedure. An ex tension shall not be considered approved unless granted by the competent auth ority through the prescribed process. 20.All items shall be packed suitably to prevent damage during transportation, l oading, unloading and storage. Packaging shall identify the product, make, mod el, quantity and relevant handling instructions, where applicable. 21.Furniture, glass-top tables, mirrors, electrical appliances, lighting equipment and other fragile or bulky items shall be protected with suitable cushioning, edg e protection and secure packing. 22.The supplier shall replace any item damaged during transit or handling, with out additional cost to the purchaser. 23.The purchaser or its authorized representative shall have the right to inspect and verify the supplied items against the contract specifications. 24.Inspection may include verification of quantity, make, model, dimensions, m aterial, finish, capacity, accessories, safety features, serial numbers, document ation and physical condition. 25.Equipment requiring installation or commissioning shall be inspected and tes ted after installation, as applicable. 26.The supplier shall provide reasonable assistance, technical personnel, tools, testing arrangements and demonstrations required for inspection and acceptan ce, without additional cost where included in the contract. 27.The purchaser may reject goods that are defective, damaged, incomplete, c ounterfeit, materially non-compliant or otherwise not in accordance with the co ntract. 28.Rejected items shall be removed and replaced by the supplier within the peri od stipulated by the purchaser, subject to the applicable GeM contract provision s. All costs associated with removal, replacement and re-delivery shall be borne by the supplier where rejection is attributable to supplier non-compliance. 29.For items where installation, commissioning or demonstration is expressly specified, the supplier shall provide these services at the designated site.The su pplier shall arrange qualified and competent personnel, tools, equipment and n ecessary installation accessories. 30.Installation shall be carried out in accordance with the manufacturer's instru ctions, applicable safety requirements and site conditions.The supplier shall coo rdinate with the consignee regarding installation schedules, access to the premi ses and availability of utilities.

31.Following installation, the supplier shall conduct functional testing and demo nstrate the operation, safety features and basic maintenance requirements of t he equipment to the nominated representative. 32.The supplier shall rectify installation-related defects and complete commissi oning before the item is offered for final acceptance. Installation, commissionin g and demonstration certificates shall be submitted wherever applicable. 33.All goods shall carry the manufacturer's warranty or the warranty period spe cifically stipulated in the bid, whichever contractual requirement is applicable. 34.Warranty shall cover manufacturing defects, defects in materials and workm anship and failures arising during normal use in accordance with the manufactu rer's operating instructions. 35.During the warranty period, the supplier shall repair or replace defective co mponents or equipment, as appropriate, without charging the purchaser for cov ered parts, labour or service visits. 36.The supplier shall provide warranty support through its own service facility o r authorised service network. The supplier shall provide the relevant service con tact details and escalation mechanism. 37.The supplier shall acknowledge warranty complaints within a reasonable tim e and attend to them within the response and resolution periods specified in th e GeM contract or manufacturer's warranty terms, where applicable. 38.If the equipment cannot be repaired within a reasonable period, the supplier shall provide a suitable replacement or other remedy in accordance with the co ntract. 39.Warranty shall not be reduced or invalidated by the supplier's failure to hand over warranty documents, provided the purchaser has fulfilled the applicable co ntractual requirements. 40.Any exclusion for damage arising from misuse, unauthorized repair, abnorm al operating conditions or other causes shall be subject to the manufacturer's w arranty and the applicable contract. Such exclusions shall not be used to avoid responsibility for manufacturing defects or supplier-related installation deficienc ies. 41.The supplier shall provide the following documents, as applicable to the item : (a) Manufacturer's user/operating manual. (b) Installation and commissioning instructions. (c) Warranty card or warranty certificate. (d) Product datasheet and technical specifications.

(e) Serial number and model identification details. (f) Safety instructions and maintenance schedule. (g) Electrical diagrams, plumbing diagrams or other technical drawings, wherev er applicable. (h) Test reports, compliance certificates and service contact details, wherever r equired. 42.Manuals and operating instructions shall be supplied in English or in another language acceptable to the consignee. The supplier shall explain the safe opera tion, basic troubleshooting, cleaning and routine maintenance of equipment req uiring user familiarisation. 43.Electrical and electronic equipment shall be suitable for the voltage, frequen cy and power supply available at the delivery location, as prescribed in the rele vant specifications.The supplied equipment shall comply with applicable Indian safety standards, statutory requirements and mandatory certifications relevant to the product category. 44.Where BIS certification, energy-efficiency labelling or another statutory certif ication is mandatory for the offered product, the bidder shall ensure valid compl iance. 45.Electrical connections, wiring, earthing and installation shall be carried out b y competent personnel in accordance with applicable safety requirements. DF or other construction material, as applicable to the item. The supplier shall n ot substitute a specified material without approval. Any wobbling, loose f itting or assembly defect shall be rectified before acceptance. 48.Mobile tower light (a) The mobile tower light shall conform to the prescribed LED wattage, mast he ight, mast type, raising mechanism, rotation, generator capacity, engine, fuel ta nk, running time, starting system, control panel, trailer, tyres, stabilisers, brakin g system, dimensions, weight, IP rating and electrical system.
